data.title: 星熊 · 露台上的冰饮
data.description: 碰杯后她没有坐回去，而是手肘撑在桌边看你，笑说今晚没安排，足够把想听的话听完。
data.action: 举杯倾身，带笑直视镜头
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: On a moonlit balcony overlooking the sprawling city skyline, Hoshiguma leans forward, a chilled glass in hand, her confident smile illuminated by soft, warm lantern light. The metal railing is silhouetted against the vibrant city lights below, creating a relaxed and intimate atmosphere.
data.animaCaption: Leaning forward on a moonlit balcony with a chilled glass lifted in hand, she meets the viewer's gaze with a confident smile. Warm lantern light softens her features against the dark railing and sparkling skyline below.
